name: Stonetoss
description:
Stonetoss (@stonetoss), the cartoonist behind the Flurks NFT collection. Live Flurks floor and top bid from the NFTX v2 FLURK vault, the Element Market listing, and Bitcoin Obama's December 2024 call of a “50 ETH floor”.
Cartoonist; creator of the Flurks NFT collection and the $BURGERS token.
His main tie to the Bitcoin Obama story is the Flurks NFT collection.

Facts (Bitcoin Obama Wiki, https://bitcoinobama.com/stonetoss):
- Also called: stonetoss, Stonetoss, Stone Toss, @stonetoss.
- Stonetoss (@stonetoss, “Stonetoss Comics”) is a web cartoonist known for the StoneToss comic strips at stonetoss.com.
- His main tie to the Bitcoin Obama story is the Flurks NFT collection.
- On Dec 13, 2024 Obama shilled Flurks as his first NFT shill and predicted “We are hit 50 ETH floor soon”.
- Because OpenSea banned Flurks, this page tracks its floor through the NFTX v2 FLURK vault and Element Market instead.
- Stonetoss posts on X as @stonetoss.
- No direct exchange with Bitcoin Obama found; Obama shilled his Flurks in December 2024 (“We are hit 50 ETH floor soon”) and promised $BURGERS content.
- Stonetoss is Cartoonist; creator of the Flurks NFT collection and the $BURGERS token.
- X: @stonetoss (“Stonetoss Comics”)
- Known for: StoneToss web comics (stonetoss.com)
- NFTs: Flurks by Stonetoss (2021), $BURGERS (2024)
- Flurks markets: NFTX v2 vault, Element, Scatter; banned from OpenSea
- Relationship to Bitcoin Obama: No direct exchange with Bitcoin Obama found; Obama shilled his Flurks in December 2024 (“We are hit 50 ETH floor soon”) and promised $BURGERS content
- Interests: webcomics with one-line captions, reddit-mocking meme takes, US midterms jokes, No Nut November, holidays and spooky season, AI prompt jokes.
- Stonetoss is a pseudonymous webcomic artist.
personality: deadpan, terse, ironic, contrarian, meme-literate, provocative, part of the Bitcoin Obama story.
